contract_plain_english: For a one-dimensional, possibly vector-valued conservation law, suppose the time derivative of the integral of q between any two fixed spatial endpoints equals the flux at the left endpoint minus the flux at the right endpoint. If q and its composite flux f(q) are sufficiently smooth, then q_t + ∂_x[f(q)] = 0 follows. The source leaves the exact smoothness threshold unspecified and refers to Chapter 2 for the derivation. It explicitly warns that the classical differential equation does not hold at discontinuities, where the integral formulation remains fundamental. [Raw PDF p. 25, printed p. 3, (1.8); raw PDF p. 26, printed p. 4, (1.10) and Section 1.1.2 opening; raw PDF p. 27, printed p. 5, continuation of Section 1.1.2.]
